title: UatPlanBlind
description: Canonical carrier for the FROZEN blind scenario plan (plan A6, round-3 finding 6). The blind planner emits this JSON in a hermetic runtime BEFORE reading any prior conclusion; the `.md` view is generated from it. All digests operate on this canonical JSON via RFC 8785, never on rendered Markdown. `document_sha256` is the whole-document digest computed over this object with the `document_sha256` field EXCLUDED (a document never contains its own hash); each scenario carries its own excluded-self `digest`. Once frozen, the blind scenario set can only be added to (augmentation), never mutated, deleted, or downgraded — the evidence validator enforces blind ⊆ final-required ⊆ executed against this frozen set.

input_manifest_sha256.description: Digest of the hash-bound blind input package the planner was given.

risk_baseline.description: The independently-derived layer-1 baseline (classifier), hash-bound. The planner may add risks but never remove one.

origin.description: Every scenario in the blind plan has origin=blind.

anti_vacuity_contract.description: The structured proof the executed scenario MUST later produce (record count, seeded id/value, branch marker, response field).

digest.description: RFC 8785 digest of this scenario with its own `digest` field excluded.
